title: Stride length not recording
body:
I’m a slow jogger and after the update to watchOS 10.1, I noticed that Stride Length no longer shows up on my metrics. 

Even after receiving help from the Apple Engineers, the problem wasn’t solved. 

Thereafter, I did several experiments on my Apple Watch Ultra and my wife’s Apple Watch Series 7. I think I found the issue. There seemed to be a lower limit now for stride length before it shows up, and I believe the limit is 0.6m. When we do slow jogging at conversational pace, stride length went to 0.4-0.5m and will not show up on the Apple Watches. Once we pick up the pace, above 0.6m and the stride length metric works normally. 

Prior to watchOS 10.1, the Apple Watches will measure stride length down to 0.4m, maybe even lower. I don’t understand the reason to implement the lower limit and exclude the slow joggers from a useful metric like stride length. 

Can the engineers remove the lower limit of stride length so all runners of varying age, fitness and training objective can benefit from it?

Thank you.
